# Vendored libraries

Bundled here so the site does not depend on a CDN on the day.

| File | Library | Version | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `peerjs.min.js` | [PeerJS](https://github.com/peers/peerjs) | 1.5.5 | MIT |
| `qrcode.mjs` | [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) by Kazuhiko Arase | 2.0.4 | MIT |

To update, download the new `dist/` files from npm (`npm pack peerjs qrcode-generator`) and replace these.
